phase_name: Forgery Probes, Fail-Open Cases, and the Buried-Long-Line Case

objectives.description: Probe A: stub terminal exit 2 -> exit 0, breaks case 1 (modification predicate)
Probe B: stub scope case to always-match, breaks case 8 (scope-match predicate, admit-half probe)
Probe C: stub HEAD lookup to return on-disk content, breaks case 9 (HEAD-baseline predicate)
Fail-open case 1 (jq absent, coreutils-only PATH, environment-specific graceful skip)
Fail-open case 2 (malformed stdin, distinct WARNING naming guard 2)
Buried-long-line case (8072-char line, embedded-marker modification refused) + companion admit (unchanged long line + append allowed)

approaches_tried.approach: Fail-open case 1 via PATH=/nonexistent-dir (blanks PATH entirely)
approaches_tried.reason: script crashes before guard 1 even runs, since HOOK_DIR resolution needs dirname/cd which are themselves unavailable -- replaced with a coreutils-only PATH (dirname of `command -v cat`) that excludes only jq's directory, with a graceful environment-specific skip if jq happens to be co-located with coreutils on the test machine
